UPDATE normal_group_creation_item SET status = CASE WHEN create_partial = 1 THEN 'CREATED_PARTIAL' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM normal_group_creation_item_member member WHERE member.tenant_id = normal_group_creation_item.tenant_id AND member.item_id = normal_group_creation_item.id AND member.participant_status NOT IN ('OK', 'ALREADY_IN', 'CONFIRMED') ) THEN 'CREATED_PARTIAL' ELSE 'CREATED' END, current_step = 'DONE', dispatch_stage = 'NONE', dispatch_status = 'NONE', settings_status = #{settingsStatus}, processing_started_at = NULL, creator_leave_status = #{leaveStatus}, last_event_id = #{eventId}, last_error_code = NULL, last_error_message = NULL, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{itemId} AND current_step = 'POST_PROCESSING' AND dispatch_status = 'PROCESSING' AND last_event_id = #{eventId} AND group_jid IS NOT NULL

UPDATE normal_group_creation_item SET status = 'PENDING', dispatch_stage = CASE current_step WHEN 'PREPARING_CONTACTS' THEN 'PREPARE' WHEN 'CREATING_GROUP' THEN 'CREATE' WHEN 'POST_PROCESSING' THEN 'POST_PROCESS' ELSE dispatch_stage END, dispatch_status = 'PENDING', next_dispatch_at = #{now}, processing_started_at = NULL, last_event_id = NULL, last_error_code = NULL, last_error_message = NULL, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{itemId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND current_step IN ('PREPARING_CONTACTS', 'CREATING_GROUP', 'POST_PROCESSING') AND status = 'FAILED'

UPDATE normal_group_creation_item SET status = CASE WHEN CASE current_step WHEN 'PREPARING_CONTACTS' THEN prepare_attempt_count WHEN 'CREATING_GROUP' THEN create_attempt_count WHEN 'POST_PROCESSING' THEN post_attempt_count ELSE #{maxAttempts} END < #{maxAttempts} THEN 'PENDING' WHEN current_step = 'CREATING_GROUP' THEN 'RESULT_UNKNOWN' WHEN current_step = 'POST_PROCESSING' THEN 'CREATED_PARTIAL' ELSE 'FAILED' END, dispatch_stage = CASE WHEN CASE current_step WHEN 'PREPARING_CONTACTS' THEN prepare_attempt_count WHEN 'CREATING_GROUP' THEN create_attempt_count WHEN 'POST_PROCESSING' THEN post_attempt_count ELSE #{maxAttempts} END < #{maxAttempts} THEN dispatch_stage ELSE 'NONE' END, dispatch_status = CASE WHEN CASE current_step WHEN 'PREPARING_CONTACTS' THEN prepare_attempt_count WHEN 'CREATING_GROUP' THEN create_attempt_count WHEN 'POST_PROCESSING' THEN post_attempt_count ELSE #{maxAttempts} END < #{maxAttempts} THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'NONE' END, next_dispatch_at = #{nextDispatchAt}, processing_started_at = NULL, last_event_id = CASE WHEN CASE current_step WHEN 'PREPARING_CONTACTS' THEN prepare_attempt_count WHEN 'CREATING_GROUP' THEN create_attempt_count WHEN 'POST_PROCESSING' THEN post_attempt_count ELSE #{maxAttempts} END < #{maxAttempts} THEN NULL ELSE #{eventId} END, last_error_code = #{errorCode}, last_error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{itemId} AND current_step = #{expectedStep} AND dispatch_status = 'PROCESSING' AND last_event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE normal_group_creation_item SET status = CASE WHEN current_step = 'CREATING_GROUP' THEN 'RESULT_UNKNOWN' WHEN current_step = 'POST_PROCESSING' THEN 'CREATED_PARTIAL' WHEN prepare_attempt_count >= #{maxAttempts} THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'PENDING' END, dispatch_stage = CASE current_step WHEN 'PREPARING_CONTACTS' THEN CASE WHEN prepare_attempt_count >= #{maxAttempts} THEN 'NONE' ELSE 'PREPARE' END ELSE 'NONE' END, dispatch_status = CASE WHEN current_step = 'PREPARING_CONTACTS' THEN CASE WHEN prepare_attempt_count >= #{maxAttempts} THEN 'NONE' ELSE 'PENDING' END ELSE 'NONE' END, next_dispatch_at = #{now}, processing_started_at = NULL, last_event_id = NULL, last_error_code = 'PROCESSING_LEASE_EXPIRED', last_error_message = CASE WHEN current_step = 'CREATING_GROUP' THEN '建群执行中断，协议结果不确定，必须人工对账' WHEN current_step = 'POST_PROCESSING' THEN '群后处理执行中断，管理员移交或退群结果不确定，必须人工对账' WHEN prepare_attempt_count >= #{maxAttempts} THEN '联系人准备阶段连续执行中断，已达到自动尝试上限' ELSE '阶段执行租约过期，已进入安全补偿' END, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{itemId} AND current_step = #{expectedStep} AND dispatch_status = 'PROCESSING' AND processing_started_at IS NOT NULL AND processing_started_at <= #{processingBefore} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE normal_group_creation_task task SET success_count = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM normal_group_creation_item item WHERE item.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND item.task_id = task.id AND item.deleted_at IS NULL AND item.status IN ('CREATED', 'CREATED_PARTIAL') ), failed_count = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM normal_group_creation_item item WHERE item.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND item.task_id = task.id AND item.deleted_at IS NULL AND item.status IN ('FAILED', 'RESULT_UNKNOWN') ), status = CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM normal_group_creation_item item WHERE item.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND item.task_id = task.id AND item.deleted_at IS NULL AND item.status NOT IN ('CREATED', 'CREATED_PARTIAL', 'FAILED', 'RESULT_UNKNOWN')) > 0 THEN 'RUNNING' WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM normal_group_creation_item item WHERE item.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND item.task_id = task.id AND item.deleted_at IS NULL AND item.status = 'CREATED_PARTIAL') > 0 THEN 'PARTIAL' WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM normal_group_creation_item item WHERE item.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND item.task_id = task.id AND item.deleted_at IS NULL AND item.status IN ('FAILED', 'RESULT_UNKNOWN')) = 0 THEN 'SUCCESS' WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM normal_group_creation_item item WHERE item.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND item.task_id = task.id AND item.deleted_at IS NULL AND item.status IN ('CREATED', 'CREATED_PARTIAL')) = 0 THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'PARTIAL' END, updated_at = #{now} WHERE task.id = #{taskId} AND task.deleted_at IS NULL
